Expectation, probability and distribution functions

Source: R/stats-aa-rv.R
E.Rd

E(expr, condition) (alias expectation()) is the expected value of a random expression; P(condition, given_condition) (alias probability()) the probability of an event. rv_density() is SymPy's density(): a distribution, a Lambda, or a finite density mapping; rv_cdf() is cdf(), and characteristic_function(), moment_generating_function() and rv_quantile() (SymPy's quantile()) return Lambda functions. Apply the result to a value with apply_lambda(). For compatibility, a non-Boolean second argument to rv_density() and rv_cdf() is a point at which to evaluate. H() (alias entropy()) is the entropy.

Usage

E(expr, condition = NULL, numsamples = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

expectation(expr, condition = NULL, numsamples = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

P(condition, given_condition = NULL, numsamples = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

probability(
  condition,
  given_condition = NULL,
  numsamples = NULL,
  evaluate = TRUE,
  ...
)

rv_density(expr, condition = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, numsamples = NULL, ...)

Density(expr, condition = NULL, ...)

rv_cdf(expr, condition = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

characteristic_function(expr, condition = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

moment_generating_function(expr, condition = NULL, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

rv_quantile(expr, evaluate = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

expr

A random expression.

condition

An optional condition (Relational or Boolean).

numsamples

Sampling is not supported; must be NULL.

evaluate

FALSE keeps integrals and sums unevaluated.

...

Ignored, except by Density(): further list(state, probability) pairs of a quantum density operator (density-operators).

given_condition

An optional condition for P().

Value

An expression, a distribution, a Lambda or a mapping.

Examples

X <- Normal("X", 0, 1)
E(X^2)
#> 1
P(X > 0)
#> 1/2
rv_density(X)
#> NormalDistribution(0, 1)
apply_lambda(rv_cdf(X), 0)
#> 1/2
D <- Die("D", 6)
E(D)
#> 7/2
P(D > 4)
#> 1/3
